episodes.title: Noah Shinn - Building Instinct: The Personal Agent - [Invest Like the Best, EP.493]
episodes.desc: My guest today is Noah Shinn. Noah is the founder of Instinct, a personal assistant that you text, call, or email the same way you would a person. episodes.title: Who Feeds the GPUs? Inside AI's Hidden $30B Layer | Renen Hallak, VAST Data
episodes.desc: Everyone talks about GPUs. Almost nobody talks about the layer that feeds them.
